requirements.requirement: The system must expose a GET endpoint in evaluate_care_facade that returns prescription behavior analysis for a given provider NPI.
The system must return a normalized prescribing appropriateness score in the API response.
The system must include a structured summary of prescribing patterns mapped to conditions in the API response.
The system must integrate with the scoring service produced in EVAL-P-RX-S3 to retrieve computed scores.
The system must validate that the provider NPI input is present and correctly formatted before processing the request.
The system must return HTTP 404 when no prescribing data exists for the requested provider.
The system must return HTTP 400 when the input NPI is missing or invalid.
The system must return responses in JSON format consistent with existing evaluate_care_facade response patterns.
The system must include condition-level breakdowns of prescribing behavior in the response payload.
The system must ensure the API response latency does not exceed 2 seconds under normal load.
The system must include an LLM-generated natural language summary explaining the prescribing score.
The system must ensure the LLM summary references at least one condition-treatment relationship.
The system must ensure the LLM summary avoids hallucinating conditions or drugs not present in the underlying data.
The system must ensure the LLM summary is deterministic for the same input data within a tolerance of semantic equivalence.
The system must ensure the LLM summary length does not exceed a predefined token limit.
The system must ensure the LLM output is generated only after structured scoring data is available.
The system must include a confidence indicator for the LLM-generated summary.
The system must ensure the LLM summary uses consumer-friendly language suitable for non-clinical users.
The system must ensure the LLM summary highlights any detected prescribing anomalies or outliers.
The system must ensure the LLM summary does not include protected health information (PHI).
